claims: The Artemis II splashdown is scheduled for Friday, April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II splashdown is scheduled at approximately 8:07 p.m. ET (5:07 p.m. PT).
The Artemis II splashdown is scheduled off the San Diego coast.
Live coverage of the Artemis II splashdown begins at 6:30 p.m. ET on NASA+, YouTube, Netflix, Prime Video, HBO Max, Peacock, and Discovery+.
Official NASA coverage of the Artemis II splashdown is on NASA+, NASA YouTube channel, or the NASA app.
Netflix, Amazon Prime, HBO Max, Peacock, and Roku are broadcasting the Artemis II splashdown.
CBS News, ABC News, and CNN will provide coverage of the Artemis II splashdown on their respective networks and apps.
The Artemis Real-time Orbit Website (AROW) shows the Orion capsule's journey in real-time.
San Diego Air & Space Museum is hosting a family-friendly viewing party for the Artemis II splashdown.
The NY Times is providing a live video player for the Artemis II splashdown.
